entries.27038c74c82c1af3: As its basic management policy, the company aims to grow as a company that contributes to the advancement of industry and the maintenance and improvement of people's safe and comfortable lives through manufacturing technology and the services based on it. As a priority issue, in the energy field, given that the 7th Strategic Energy Plan sets out a policy of maximizing the use of nuclear power, the company says it will focus on test and research relating to next-generation innovative reactors and nuclear fusion and invest in technology development. In the industrial systems field, the company says it will focus on securing orders for sheathed thermocouples and sheathed heaters, which are core products for semiconductor manufacturing equipment.

entries.f7abc8b5a80e3c2f: Since it began manufacturing and selling simulated fuel rods for fast breeder reactor experiments in 1968, the company has long produced products for test and research in the nuclear field. It has its own products such as sheathed thermocouples, sheathed heaters and electromagnetic pumps, and its Takahagi Plant has test facilities including a clean room building and a molten metal test building.
entries.f8e07be355a4089f: In the fiscal year ended September 2025, energy-related net sales rose 23.9% from the previous fiscal year, while industrial systems-related net sales increased only 1.2%, making energy-related the segment with the larger net sales. Because its production is made to order and workloads by department change with timing, the company is promoting multi-skilling, mainly among younger employees, so they can master the work techniques of other departments, and says it will make staffing more flexible.
